title: Runner contract: shared definitions
description: JSON-RPC 2.0 envelopes and values shared by every message of the runner contract. Each message is one line of UTF-8 JSON on the runner's standard input or standard output.

id.title: Request id
id.description: Correlates a response with its request.

runId.title: Run id
runId.description: Chosen by troupe for each run attempt.

sha256Ref.title: Artifact reference
sha256Ref.description: sha256: followed by the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the artifact's bytes.

successResponse.title: Success response
successResponse.description: A response to a request. Its result is checked against the result schema of the request's method.
